data.body: The final recommendation filter completed at origin/main f39a32c34e7c6e66d1e1bcd7e0631c98a79aa08c. It retained F50, F51, F52A, F52B, F53, F54A, F54B, F56, F57, F58, and F59. F55 remains deferred pending infrastructure approval. F60 remains held until the GitHub Issues setting is reconciled with the operator decision that Issues is disabled and future integration is planned. F02 through F04 remain rejected. F05 and F24 remain deferred. F51 precedes F56 because both edit README.md. F50 precedes F54B where help sources overlap. F57 follows the prior rejection of moving historical artifacts and instead labels them in place.
